thag16.2:1.1: Samaṇassa ahū cintā Pārāpariyassa bhikkhuno ekakassa nisinnassa pavivittassa jhāyino: || ||
thag16.2:2.1: kim ānupubbaṃ puriso kiṃ vataṃ kiṃ samācāraṃ attano kiccakāri 'ssa na ca kiñci viheṭhaye. || ||
thag16.2:3.1: indriyāni manussānaṃ hitāya ahitāya ca: arakkhitāni ahitāya rakkhitāni hitāya ca. || ||
thag16.2:4.1: indriyān' eva sārakkhaṃ indriyāni ca gopayaṃ attano kiccakāri 'ssa na ca kiñci viheṭhaye. || ||
thag16.2:5.1: cakkhundriyañ ce rūpesu gacchantaṃ anivārayaṃ anādīnavadassāvī, so dukkhā na hi muccati. || ||
thag16.2:6.1: sotindriyañ ca saddesu gacchantaṃ anivārayaṃ anādīnavadassāvī, so dukkhā na hi muccati. || ||
thag16.2:7.1: anissaraṇadassāvī gandhe ce paṭisevati, na so muccati dukkhamhā gandhesu adhimucchito. || ||
thag16.2:8.1: ambilamadhuraggañ ca tittakaggam anussaraṃ rasataṇhāya gadhito hadayaṃ nāvabujjhati. || ||
thag16.2:9.1: subhāny appaṭikūlāni phoṭṭhabbāni anussaraṃ ratto rāgādhikaraṇaṃ vividhaṃ vindate dukhaṃ. || ||
thag16.2:10.1: manañ c' etehi dhammehi yo na sakkoti rakkhituṃ, tato naṃ dukkham anveti sabbeh' etehi pañcahi. || ||
thag16.2:11.1: pubbalohitasampuṇṇaṃ bahussa kuṇapassa ca naravīrakataṃ vagguṃ samuggam iva cittitaṃ || ||
thag16.2:12.1: kaṭukaṃ madhurassādaṃ piyanibandhanaṃ dukhaṃ khuraṃ va madhunālittaṃ ullittaṃ nāvabujjhati. || ||
thag16.2:13.1: itthirūpe itthirase phoṭṭhabbe pi ca itthiyā itthigandhesu sāratto vividhaṃ vindate dukhaṃ. || ||
thag16.2:14.1: itthisotāni sabbāni sandanti pañcapañcasu; tesaṃ āvaraṇaṃ kātuṃ yo sakkoti viriyavā, || ||
thag16.2:15.1: so atthavā, so dhammaṭṭho, so dakkho, so vicakkhaṇo, kareyya ramamāno hi kiccaṃ dhammatthasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
thag16.2:16.1: atho sīdati saññuttaṃ vajje kiccaṃ niratthakaṃ, na taṃ kiccan ti maññitvā appamatto vicakkhaṇo. || ||
thag16.2:17.1: yañ ca atthena saññuttaṃ yā ca dhammagatā rati taṃ samādāya vattetha, sa hi ve uttamā rati. || ||
thag16.2:18.1: uccāvaceh' upāyehi paresam abhijigīsāti hantvā vadhitvā atha socayitvā ālopati sāhasā yo paresaṃ, || ||
thag16.2:19.1: tacchanto āṇiyā āṇiṃ nihanti balavā yathā: indriyān' indriyeh' eva nihanti kusalā tathā. || ||
thag16.2:20.1: saddhaṃ viriyaṃ samādhiñ ca satipaññañ ca bhāvayaṃ pañca pañcahi hantvāna anīgho yāti brāhmaṇo. || ||
thag16.2:21.1: so atthavā so dhammaṭṭho katvā vākyānusāsaniṃ sabbena sabbaṃ buddhassa, so naro sukham edhatīti. || || Pārāpariyo thero.
